basis-ng is an Angular UI library composed of two main packages:
- @basis-ng/primitives: standalone Angular components, directives, pipes, and services
- @basis-ng/styles: optional style layer for those primitives

Quick usage rules:
- Install both packages when you want styled components: npm install @basis-ng/primitives @basis-ng/styles
- Components are standalone and imported directly into Angular component imports arrays
- Most component selectors use the b- prefix, for example b-drawer, button[b-button], b-alert
- Components are intentionally headless without the matching style import
- Global styles can be imported with @import '@basis-ng/styles';
- Component styles can be imported individually, for example @import '@basis-ng/styles/drawer';
- Prefer the component documentation pages from the docs site as the canonical usage examples

Public references:
- LLM-focused reference: https://basis.ng/ai-reference.md
- Component documentation lives under https://basis.ng/docs/components/*

Important patterns:
- Use Angular signals for local state in examples
- Use input()/output()/model() APIs instead of decorator-based inputs and outputs
- Use native Angular control flow (@if, @for, @switch)
- When in doubt, prefer examples already present in the docs app over inventing new APIs
